description: Every AI prompt, one per data point. Built from the files in this folder.

prompts.data_point: Based and operating in the US
prompts.run_when: Code found no US address or US governing law, or found mixed US and foreign clues.

prompts.data_point: Live website with a real product or service
prompts.run_when: The site loaded but looked thin (little text or few pages).

prompts.data_point: Uses a fintech tool Puzzle connects to
prompts.run_when: Code found a mention of one of the tools but couldn't tell if the company itself uses it.

prompts.data_point: Real transaction activity
prompts.run_when: Code found no prices, checkout, app store link or open jobs, but the site is live.

prompts.data_point: Raised Series C or later, or publicly traded
prompts.run_when: Code found a Series C+ mention, a stock ticker or an investor relations page.

prompts.data_point: Newly incorporated, no live website, no disclosed funding
prompts.run_when: The website did not load and search results are available.

prompts.data_point: Accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or fractional CFO firm
prompts.run_when: Code found accounting, CPA, bookkeeping or fractional CFO wording in the page title or headline.

prompts.data_point: Operates primarily outside the US or reports in non-USD currency
prompts.run_when: Code found foreign clues (legal entity, address, governing law, country domain, currency).

prompts.data_point: Non-profit, charity, foundation, association or government body
prompts.run_when: Code found 501(c)(3), charity, tax-deductible or donation wording, or a donate button.

prompts.data_point: E-commerce or retail business holding physical inventory
prompts.run_when: Code found a store platform, 'add to cart', stock labels or shipping pages.

prompts.data_point: Venture-backed at pre-seed, seed, Series A or Series B
prompts.run_when: Code found no clear funding statement, or found investors without a stage.

prompts.data_point: Uses Stripe for billing or subscription revenue
prompts.run_when: Code found Stripe mentioned but not in a way that proves usage.

prompts.data_point: Delaware C-Corporation
prompts.run_when: Code found an 'Inc.' name but no Delaware governing law, or the entity was unclear.

prompts.data_point: Currently on QuickBooks Online
prompts.run_when: QuickBooks was mentioned on the site or in job posts.

prompts.data_point: Operates as a startup selling nationally
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: B2B SaaS or tech-enabled service sold beyond one metro
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Professional services business serving a single metro area
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Publishes real paid pricing
prompts.run_when: Code found a pricing page but couldn't read prices from it.

prompts.data_point: Runs payroll on Gusto, Rippling or Deel
prompts.run_when: Code found Gusto, Rippling or Deel mentioned but couldn't confirm usage.

prompts.data_point: AI or machine learning is core to their own product
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Backed by Y Combinator or a comparable accelerator
prompts.run_when: Code found an accelerator mention that may not be the company's own backing.

prompts.data_point: Active careers page with several open roles
prompts.run_when: A careers page was found but no known job board, so roles couldn't be counted.

prompts.data_point: No dedicated accounting or finance person visible
prompts.run_when: A team page was found.

prompts.data_point: Controller, Head of Finance or finance team present (mid-size and up)
prompts.run_when: A team page was found.

prompts.data_point: Publishes ARR, customer count or growth milestones
prompts.run_when: Code found a possible metric that needs confirming.

prompts.data_point: Remote-first or hybrid operations
prompts.run_when: Code found no remote wording and no remote job flags, but a careers or about page exists.

prompts.data_point: Runs several US legal entities under common ownership
prompts.run_when: Code found 'Holdings', 'portfolio company' or 'family of companies' wording.

prompts.data_point: Early-adopter posture
prompts.run_when: Code found no Product Hunt link or engineering blog, but a blog exists.

prompts.data_point: Banks with Mercury or Brex
prompts.run_when: Code found Mercury or Brex mentioned but couldn't confirm usage.

prompts.data_point: Uses Ramp or Brex for corporate cards and spend
prompts.run_when: Code found Ramp or Brex mentioned but couldn't confirm usage.

prompts.data_point: Cap table managed in Carta or Pulley
prompts.run_when: Code found Carta or Pulley mentioned but couldn't confirm usage.

prompts.data_point: Announced a funding round in the last six months
prompts.run_when: Web search results about the company's funding are available.

prompts.data_point: A new institutional investor or accelerator affiliation appeared
prompts.run_when: Web search results or a new directory listing are available.

prompts.data_point: Actively hiring across several open roles
prompts.run_when: A careers page was found but roles couldn't be counted from a job board.

prompts.data_point: Open role for a Controller, Head of Finance or first finance hire
prompts.run_when: Job titles are available and one may be a finance role.

prompts.data_point: Open role for operations, business operations or chief of staff
prompts.run_when: Job titles are available and one may be an ops role.

prompts.data_point: Recently converted from an LLC to a Delaware C-Corporation
prompts.run_when: An older snapshot of the site or registry results are available.

prompts.data_point: Incorporated within the last 12 months, funded, with a live product
prompts.run_when: Registry or filing results are available.

prompts.data_point: Registered a new subsidiary or additional operating entity
prompts.run_when: Registry or news results are available.

prompts.data_point: Recently parted ways with, or is replacing, a bookkeeper or fractional CFO
prompts.run_when: A bookkeeper or finance role is open, or search results are available.

prompts.data_point: Publicly complaining about QuickBooks
prompts.run_when: Web search results mentioning the company or founders with QuickBooks are available.

prompts.data_point: Recently launched paid pricing, a new revenue line or subscription billing
prompts.run_when: An older snapshot of the pricing page or a launch post is available.

prompts.data_point: Announced a new board member or began publishing investor updates
prompts.run_when: Web search results are available.

prompts.data_point: Preparing for a first audit or diligence process
prompts.run_when: A finance job post or search results mention audits.

prompts.data_point: Serves a single metro area or local service radius
prompts.run_when: Code found a locations page, 'areas we serve' wording or local business data.

prompts.data_point: Revenue is billed labour rather than a product
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Physical or single-location operation
prompts.run_when: Code found opening hours, a menu page or local business data.

prompts.data_point: Organised as an LLC or sole proprietorship with no discoverable venture funding
prompts.run_when: The entity type is LLC or sole proprietorship and no funding was found.

prompts.data_point: Pre-revenue with minimal operating activity
prompts.run_when: Code found waitlist or early-access wording and no pricing or checkout.

prompts.data_point: Requires multi-currency or non-USD reporting
prompts.run_when: Code found prices in several currencies or a currency switcher.

prompts.data_point: Manufacturing or hardware operations
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Heavy accounts-receivable or accounts-payable workflows
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Shopify or similar storefront that does not hold inventory
prompts.run_when: Code found a store platform but no proof of physical stock.

prompts.data_point: Already running an established ERP with a full in-house accounting team
prompts.run_when: Job posts mention NetSuite or QuickBooks Enterprise.

prompts.data_point: Tooling decisions controlled by an incumbent accountant or bookkeeper
prompts.run_when: Search results mention the company's accountant or CPA firm.

prompts.data_point: No fintech tooling: traditional bank and spreadsheets only
prompts.run_when: Job posts or pages describe the finance stack.

prompts.data_point: Vertical (industry)
prompts.run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompts.data_point: Segment (company size)
prompts.run_when: When the employee count from the list is missing, or a team page was found.

prompts.data_point: Legal entity type and state of incorporation
prompts.run_when: Code couldn't decide the entity type.

prompts.data_point: Competitor accounting tools in use
prompts.run_when: Job posts or pages mention accounting tools.

prompts.data_point: ICP reasoning with funding stage line
prompts.run_when: After all signals are decided and scored.

prompts.data_point: Fit message for outreach
prompts.run_when: After scoring, for companies that passed.
